facts.text: The Cleveland State Commitment provides up to eight semesters of free tuition for incoming Ohio freshmen with at least a 3.0 GPA and family incomes of $125,000 or less.

sources.title: Cleveland State Commitment | Cleveland State University
sources.quote: Beginning in fall 2027, incoming first-year students who graduate high school with a 3.0 GPA or higher, and whose families have an adjusted gross income of $125,000 or less, will pay no tuition for up to eight consecutive semesters.
